name: xlsx-tool
description: Teach AI agents to inspect and edit XLSX workbooks through a self-describing, bounded CLI.

interface.longDescription: A focused Agent Skill for a versioned agent contract, bounded XLSX reads, JSON output, atomic writes, and read-back verification.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this XLSX file and summarize its structure.
Update these spreadsheet cells and verify the result.
Find the requested values without dumping the workbook.
